man.name: Away Mode
man.author: Smult
man.description: A switch in the right column: while it's on, people who message you get an away reply (once per chat).

files.Base_Plugin.lua:
local Chat = Smult:GetService("ChatService")
local UI = Smult:GetService("UIService")
local Data = Smult:GetService("DataStoreService")

local on = Data:Get("on", false)
local text = Data:Get("text", "I'm away right now, I'll answer later 🌙")
local answered = {}

local panel = UI:CreatePanel({ Title = "Away mode", Icon = "🌙" })
panel:AddToggle("Auto-reply when I'm away", on, function(v) on = v; answered = {}; Data:Set("on", v) end)
local l = panel:AddLabel("Reply: " .. text)
panel:AddInput("Change the reply…", function(t) text = t; Data:Set("text", t); l:SetText("Reply: " .. t) end)

Chat.MessageReceived:Connect(function(msg)
    if on and not answered[msg.ChatId] then
        answered[msg.ChatId] = true
        Chat:Send(msg.ChatId, text)
    end
end)

man.name: Chat Stats
man.author: Smult
man.description: Counts today's messages and shows who talks the most.

files.Base_Plugin.lua:
local Chat = Smult:GetService("ChatService")
local UI = Smult:GetService("UIService")
local Data = Smult:GetService("DataStoreService")

local today = os.date("%Y-%m-%d")
local stats = Data:Get("stats", {})
if stats.day ~= today then stats = { day = today, total = 0, sent = 0, people = {} } end

local panel = UI:CreatePanel({ Title = "Today in chats", Icon = "📊" })
local l1 = panel:AddLabel("")
local l2 = panel:AddLabel("")

local function show()
    local best, bestN = "nobody", 0
    for name, n in pairs(stats.people) do if n > bestN then best, bestN = name, n end end
    l1:SetText(string.format("💬 %d received · ✉️ %d sent", stats.total, stats.sent))
    l2:SetText(string.format("🏆 most chatty: %s (%d)", best, bestN))
    Data:Set("stats", stats)
end

Chat.MessageReceived:Connect(function(msg)
    stats.total = stats.total + 1
    stats.people[msg.Sender.Name] = (stats.people[msg.Sender.Name] or 0) + 1
    show()
end)
Chat.MessageSent:Connect(function() stats.sent = stats.sent + 1; show() end)
show()

man.name: Focus Timer
man.author: Smult
man.description: A 25/5 focus timer in the right column that pings you when it's break time.

files.Base_Plugin.lua:
local UI = Smult:GetService("UIService")
local Notify = Smult:GetService("NotificationService")
local Sound = Smult:GetService("SoundService")

local panel = UI:CreatePanel({ Title = "Focus timer", Icon = "⏳" })
local label = panel:AddLabel("25:00 · ready")
local bar = panel:AddProgress(0)
local left, total, mode, ticker = 25 * 60, 25 * 60, "focus", nil

local function show()
    label:SetText(string.format("%02d:%02d · %s", left // 60, left % 60, mode))
    bar:SetValue(100 - left * 100 // total)
end

local function stop() if ticker then ticker.Cancel(); ticker = nil end end

panel:AddButton("▶ Start / ⏸ Pause", function()
    if ticker then stop(); return end
    ticker = task.every(1, function()
        left = left - 1
        if left <= 0 then
            mode = (mode == "focus") and "break" or "focus"
            total = (mode == "focus") and 25 * 60 or 5 * 60
            left = total
            Sound:Play("notify")
            Notify:Notify("Focus timer", mode == "break" and "Break time! ☕" or "Back to it 💪")
        end
        show()
    end)
end)
panel:AddButton("↺ Reset", function() stop(); mode = "focus"; left, total = 25 * 60, 25 * 60; show() end)
show()

man.name: Sketch Pad
man.author: Smult
man.description: Its own page in the sidebar: a canvas to doodle on with colours (shows what add-ons can do beyond themes).

files.Base_Plugin.lua:
local UI = Smult:GetService("UIService")
local page = UI:CreatePage({ Title = "Sketch Pad", Icon = "🖌️" })
page:AddLabel("Left-drag to draw · right-click to erase · keys 1-6 change colour · C clears")
local canvas = page:AddCanvas(640, 400)
local colours = { "#ffffff", "#ff4d7a", "#29e0ff", "#ffd23f", "#7cff6b", "#b26bff" }
local col, down, erase, last = colours[2], false, false, nil
local strokes = {}

local function redraw()
    canvas:Clear("#0d0b1a")
    for _, s in ipairs(strokes) do canvas:Line(s[1], s[2], s[3], s[4], s[5], s[6]) end
    for i, c in ipairs(colours) do canvas:Rect(8 + (i - 1) * 22, 8, 18, 18, c, true) end
    canvas:Rect(8 + (#colours) * 22, 8, 18, 18, col, false)
    canvas:Present()
end

canvas.MouseDown:Connect(function(x, y, button)
    if y < 28 and x < 8 + #colours * 22 then
        local i = (x - 8) // 22 + 1
        if colours[i] then col = colours[i]; redraw() end
        return
    end
    down, erase, last = true, button == 2, { x, y }
end)
canvas.MouseUp:Connect(function() down = false end)
canvas.MouseMove:Connect(function(x, y)
    if not down then return end
    strokes[#strokes + 1] = { last[1], last[2], x, y, erase and "#0d0b1a" or col, erase and 18 or 4 }
    if #strokes > 4000 then table.remove(strokes, 1) end
    last = { x, y }
    redraw()
end)
canvas.KeyDown:Connect(function(k)
    if k == "c" then strokes = {} elseif tonumber(k) and colours[tonumber(k)] then col = colours[tonumber(k)] end
    redraw()
end)
redraw()

man.name: Auto-reply
man.description: Answers messages that contain a word
man.author: you

files.Base_Plugin.lua:
local Chat = Smult:GetService("ChatService")

local replies = {
    ["ping"] = "pong 🏓",
    ["good night"] = "good night 🌙",
}

Chat.MessageReceived:Connect(function(msg)
    local text = string.lower(msg.Text)
    for word, answer in pairs(replies) do
        if string.find(text, word, 1, true) then
            Chat:Send(msg.ChatId, answer)
            return
        end
    end
end)

man.name: Own page + canvas
man.description: A whole page in the sidebar with a canvas you draw on (mouse, keys, Heartbeat)
man.author: you

files.Base_Plugin.lua:
local UI = Smult:GetService("UIService")
local Run = Smult:GetService("RunService")

local page = UI:CreatePage({ Title = "My page", Icon = "🖌️" })
page:AddLabel("Drag on the canvas to draw. Press C to clear.")
local canvas = page:AddCanvas(480, 300)

local dots = {}
local down = false
local t = 0

canvas.MouseDown:Connect(function(x, y) down = true; dots[#dots + 1] = { x, y } end)
canvas.MouseUp:Connect(function() down = false end)
canvas.MouseMove:Connect(function(x, y) if down then dots[#dots + 1] = { x, y } end end)
canvas.KeyDown:Connect(function(key) if key == "c" then dots = {} end end)

Run.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
    t = t + dt
    canvas:Clear("#0d0b1a")
    for i, d in ipairs(dots) do
        canvas:Circle(d[1], d[2], 4, string.format("#%02x%02xff", (i * 7) % 255, 120))
    end
    canvas:Text(10, 10, string.format("%d dots · %.1fs", #dots, t), "#8fe3ff", 12)
    canvas:Present()
end)

man.name: Blocks (visual)
man.author: you
man.description: Snap DOORS blocks together like Scratch - no typing needed

files.Base_Plugin.lua:
-- Made with blocks in the Coding Cult (blocks.json).
-- Changing the blocks rewrites this file, so edit the blocks, not this.

local Chat = Smult:GetService("ChatService")
local Commands = Smult:GetService("CommandService")
local Notify = Smult:GetService("NotificationService")
local Data = Smult:GetService("DataStoreService")
local vars = Data:Get("vars", {})                       -- your variables (kept between restarts)
local function save() Data:Set("vars", vars) end
local current_msg, current_chat
local function sendHere(text)
    local id = (current_msg and current_msg.ChatId) or (current_chat and current_chat.Id) or Chat:GetCurrentChat()
    if id then Chat:Send(id, text) end
end

Commands:Register("door", "made with blocks", function(args, chat)
    current_msg, current_chat = nil, chat
    if math.random(100) <= 50 then
        sendHere("🚪 the door opens... it's Rush! RUN")
    end
    sendHere("🚪 door " .. tostring(vars["pings"] or "") .. " is safe... for now")
end)

Chat.MessageReceived:Connect(function(msg)
    current_msg = msg
    if string.find(string.lower(msg.Text), string.lower("ping"), 1, true) then
        sendHere("pong 🏓")
        vars["pings"] = (tonumber(vars["pings"]) or 0) + 1; save()
    end
end)

function Plugin:OnLoad()
    Notify:Toast("Hello from blocks, " .. tostring(Smult.LocalUser.Name) .. "! 🚪", "ok")
end
